items.title: Harvey Jones Interview
items.q: I stayed on one show nine years down in Texas. P.J. Tidwell's Carnival.

ctx.x: Oh, that was in the, I was in, from 40 on, from 1940, during the 40. But from 1928 until 1940, I was with the Vaudeville show then. I stayed on one show nine years down in Texas. P.J. Tidwell's Carnival. I stayed there. I was a leading comedian down there for nine years. And then when I came off of that, then I came back and joined the Brown Skin Models out of New York.
